why: Иногда условие и результат относятся к разным временам: «Если бы я тогда поступил иначе (прошлое), сейчас я жил бы лучше (настоящее)». Для таких мыслей английский смешивает две конструкции: от третьего и второго условного. Русские бы просто сказали «бы» дважды, а в английском надо выбрать форму для каждой части.
formation: • If + Past Perfect (had + V3), would + V1
• If I had taken that job, I would be rich now. (Если бы я взял ту работу, я был бы богат сейчас.)
• Отрицание: If she hadn't moved to Berlin, she wouldn't have this job today.
• If + Past Simple, would have + V3
• If I were more careful, I wouldn't have made that mistake yesterday. (Если бы я был внимательнее, я бы не сделал вчера эту ошибку.)
• С be для всех лиц обычно were: If he were patient... (в разговоре допустимо и was).
usage: 1. Прошлое действие влияет на сегодняшнюю ситуацию: If I had learned English at school, I would speak it fluently now. (Если бы я выучил английский в школе, я бы свободно говорил на нём сейчас.)

2. Постоянная черта или состояние объясняет прошлое событие: If he weren't so lazy, he would have finished the project last week. (Если бы он не был таким ленивым, он закончил бы проект на прошлой неделе.)
3. Размышления о жизненных решениях: If we hadn't moved here, we wouldn't know our neighbors now.
4. Упрёк с учётом последствий: If you had listened to me, you wouldn't be in trouble now.
signalWords: Смотрите на метки времени в предложении: now, today, still, at the moment, these days — значит, результат в настоящем (would + V1). Yesterday, last week, in 2019, then — значит, результат в прошлом (would have + V3). Условие тоже проверяйте по смыслу: «тогда однократно» — had + V3, «вообще, по характеру» — Past Simple.
mistakes: ✗ If I would have studied medicine, I would be a doctor now. → ✓ If I had studied medicine, I would be a doctor now. (would в if-части не ставим)
✗ If I had studied medicine, I would have been a doctor now. → ✓ ... I would be a doctor now. (now — результат в настоящем)
✗ If I knew him better, I would invite him yesterday. → ✓ ... I would have invited him yesterday. (результат в прошлом)
✗ If he would be more careful, he wouldn't have broken it. → ✓ If he were more careful, he wouldn't have broken it.
✗ If I didn't miss the plane, I would be in Paris now. → ✓ If I hadn't missed the plane, I would be in Paris now. (условие в прошлом — Past Perfect)
remember: Смотри на каждую половину отдельно: условие в прошлом — had V3, условие вообще или сейчас — Past Simple; результат сейчас — would V1, результат тогда — would have V3.

exercises.instruction: Прошлое условие, настоящий результат (If + had V3, would + V1)

items.prompt: If I ___ (take) that job, I ___ (be) rich now.
If she ___ (not move) to Berlin, she ___ (not have) this great job today.
If we ___ (leave) earlier, we ___ (be) at the beach now.
If he ___ (study) medicine, he ___ (be) a doctor now.
If you ___ (listen) to me, you ___ (not be) in trouble now.
If they ___ (not sell) the shares, they ___ (own) the company today.
If I ___ (learn) English at school, I ___ (speak) it fluently now.
If she ___ (not break) her phone, she ___ (answer) me right now.
items.answer: hadn't broken, would answer / would be answering

exercises.instruction: Настоящее условие, прошлый результат (If + Past Simple, would have V3)

items.prompt: If I ___ (be) more careful, I ___ (not make) that mistake yesterday.
If he ___ (speak) better English, he ___ (get) the job last week.
If I ___ (not live) so far away, I ___ (come) to the party last night.
If she ___ (be) afraid of flying, she ___ (not take) the plane yesterday.
If we ___ (have) a bigger budget, we ___ (hire) more people last year.
If I ___ (not trust) him, I ___ (not lend) him the money last month.
If Tom ___ (be) a good manager, the team ___ (not leave) last month.
If I ___ (know) Spanish, I ___ (understand) the guide in Madrid.
If I had slept more, I (a) would feel (b) would have felt better now.
If I were rich, I (a) would have bought (b) would buy that house last year.
If we had booked earlier, we (a) wouldn't be waiting (b) wouldn't have waited in this queue now.
If he (a) were (b) had been more patient, he wouldn't have shouted at her yesterday.
If she (a) hadn't gone (b) didn't go to university, she wouldn't be a teacher today.
If I weren't so shy, I (a) would have spoken (b) would speak to her at the party last night.
If they had invested in Bitcoin in 2010, they (a) would be (b) would have been millionaires today.
If I (a) were (b) would be you, I wouldn't have accepted that offer last week.
I didn't save money, so I'm poor now.
items.answer: If I had saved money, I wouldn't be poor now.

items.prompt: He isn't a patient person, so he lost the client yesterday.
items.answer: If he were a patient person, he wouldn't have lost the client yesterday. / If he was a patient person, he wouldn't have lost the client yesterday.

items.prompt: She didn't take the medicine, so she is still ill.
items.answer: If she had taken the medicine, she wouldn't be ill now. / If she had taken the medicine, she wouldn't still be ill.

items.prompt: I don't have a car, so I took the bus this morning.
items.answer: If I had a car, I wouldn't have taken the bus this morning.

items.prompt: They didn't go to the meeting, so they don't know the plan.
items.answer: If they had gone to the meeting, they would know the plan.

items.prompt: He doesn't know SQL, so he didn't get the job.
items.answer: If he knew SQL, he would have gotten the job.

items.prompt: We didn't fix the bug last week, so the app crashes today.
items.answer: If we had fixed the bug last week, the app wouldn't crash today.

items.prompt: I'm not a morning person, so I missed the early train.
items.answer: If I were a morning person, I wouldn't have missed the early train. / If I was a morning person, I wouldn't have missed the early train.

items.prompt: Если бы я выучил английский в школе, сейчас я бы свободно на нём говорил.
items.answer: If I had learned English at school, I would speak it fluently now.

items.prompt: Если бы он был внимательнее, он бы не сделал эту ошибку.
items.answer: If he were more careful, he wouldn't have made this mistake. / If he was more careful, he wouldn't have made this mistake.

items.prompt: Если бы мы не переехали в другой город, у нас сейчас не было бы этой работы.
items.answer: If we hadn't moved to another city, we wouldn't have this job now.

items.prompt: Если бы я лучше знал город, я бы вчера не заблудился.
items.answer: If I knew the city better, I wouldn't have gotten lost yesterday.

items.prompt: Если бы она послушала совет, она бы сейчас не искала работу.
items.answer: If she had listened to the advice, she wouldn't be looking for a job now.

items.prompt: Если бы у нас был больший бюджет, мы бы наняли ещё двух разработчиков в прошлом месяце.
items.answer: If we had a bigger budget, we would have hired two more developers last month.

items.prompt: Если бы я не опоздал на самолёт, я был бы сейчас в Париже.
items.answer: If I hadn't missed the plane, I would be in Paris now.

items.prompt: Если бы я не был таким ленивым, я бы закончил этот проект на прошлой неделе.
items.answer: If I weren't so lazy, I would have finished this project last week. / If I wasn't so lazy, I would have finished this project last week.
